d: An angry witch's ghost stirs up violent storms and tumultuous events. The spirits of former teachers and students haunt an abandoned schoolhouse. A man on the verge of suicide finds inspiration when a supernatural purple light appears.

An unknown axe murderer still stalks a family he brutally murdered a century ago and then next-door a spirit with a deadly secret haunts a young couple. An off the beaten path bar is stocked with other worldly spirits.
A woman under assault by an aggressive entity is rescued by the spirit of her deceased son. A maid who was murdered in the 19th century continues to work at an old Texas hotel.
A cemetery that's home to 80,000 dead souls becomes a "ghost magnet"; a family discovers that their new home is filled with the sounds of strange footsteps and whispered conversations; and more.
Two paranormal investigators who thought they had seen it all experience something "out of a horror movie".

Guests at a Kansas hotel claim they've seen the ghost of the colonel who rebuilt the hotel in the 1860s after pro-slavery forces burned it down. Two men encounter spectral footsteps and ectoplasm in an abandoned cemetery.

A man and his girlfriend dream of owning their own "haunted attraction," but end up owning an actual haunted house; and the ghostly voice of a passenger who died in a plane crash is heard in a chilling recording.
A scientist discovers footage on his security camera that even he can't explain; and a sailing ship from the 1800's is home to a ghostly crew.

A tourist says he was knifed in the back by a violent ghost in Tombstone, Ariz.; a dead wife jealously haunts her husband and his new girlfriend; and a woman snaps the picture of a smiling apparition.

st: It Watches Me While I Sleep
d: The suburban house of two young cousins is filled with scary encounters after a demonic ceramic giraffe is brought into their home.
The historic Palmyra is haunted by a mother and her six children who died there in a fire two days before Christmas over 100 years ago.
Kim Carnes (Betty Davis Eyes) returns to her former residence a historic farmhouse in Franklin, TN, which she once shared with a childlike spirit.
Actor Richard Burgi returns to his childhood home in NJ where he and his family encountered the paranormal.
Actress Joanna Cassidy (Blade Runner, Six Feet Under) seeks out the help of psychic medium Kim Russo to find out who has been haunting her 1800s-era home in Natchitoches, LA.
Millionaire Matchmaker Patti Stanger reluctantly returns to her former dream home in Marina Del Rey where she was attacked in her bed by an aggressive spirit.
Joe Pantoliano (The Sopranos, Matrix) returns to the site of the paranormal experience he and his girlfriend had at a hotel in Sante Fe, New Mexico.
Actor Anthony Michael Hall (The Breakfast Club, Sixteen Candles, The Dead Zone) seeks the help of medium Kim Russo.
For the first time in years, Eric Mabius (Resident Evil, Ugly Betty) returns to Allaire Village to confront the ghost.
Fifty years after her life-altering paranormal experience, Valerie Harper returns to the NYC apartment where she came face to face with the spirit of a woman.
Actress Jordan Ladd (Cabin Fever, Grindhouse) anxiously returns to an old mansion in New Jersey where she once encountered a ghost as it was watching her sleep.
